headline: Uravi Defence and Technology schedules shareholders meeting
hook: Routine corporate governance filing from Uravi Defence
summary: Uravi Defence and Technology Limited has formally informed the stock exchange regarding an upcoming shareholders meeting. The notice represents a routine procedural filing for the company. No specific agenda items, financial resolutions, or major business decisions were disclosed in the announcement. Indian retail investors holding this micro-cap stock should check subsequent exchange filings for meeting agendas and voting items.
why_it_matters: Routine corporate procedure for Uravi Defence shareholders.
